subject.title: fix: OpenAI OAuth works behind fake-IP proxies

question: Should the narrowly pinned fake-IP SSRF exception cover every supported OpenAI OAuth token flow, including device-code login, rather than only browser authorization-code and refresh exchanges?
rationale: The diff changes a network-security exception, and its intended product scope determines whether device-code parity is required or intentionally excluded.

options.title: Cover all OpenAI OAuth token flows
options.body: Apply the same exact-host policy to device-code token exchange and add focused regression coverage plus real proxy proof.

options.title: Limit the exception to browser OAuth
options.body: Keep device-code blocked by design and state the supported-flow limitation explicitly before merging.

recommendation.title: Cover all OpenAI OAuth token flows
recommendation.body: Apply the same exact-host policy to device-code token exchange and add focused regression coverage plus real proxy proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged OAuth-flow work and its discussion establish the closest available history for this authentication boundary.
